reason: Both are risk-bearing commercial P&C carriers that earn premiums and sell through independent agents and brokers. AFG is a diversified national specialty insurer (specialty casualty, transportation, financial lines, crop). The comp writes mainly Florida catastrophe-exposed commercial residential property (condo, HOA, apartment, assisted living). The overlap is commercial property insurance for business-type buyers. AFG's casualty, transportation and financial lines have no counterpart in the comp, and the comp's narrow Florida focus is not AFG's core.
